traditional: 覆 A 話收到 B
jyutping: fuk1 A waa6 sau1 dou2 B

english.note: Use this when replying to someone to report that you received their message, document, or invitation.

examples.english: I reply to acknowledge that I received the document.
examples.traditional: 我覆佢話收到份文件喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 fuk1 keoi5 waa6 sau1 dou2 fan6 man4 gin2 laa3
